title: Approve the home page composition
question: Three compositions of The Annual Report. Pick the one to build; use the steer box to combine or revise (e.g. 'comp 1 cover with comp 3's contents rail').

options.label: 1 · Cover split
options.thesis: Name on an ultramarine plate of 72,000 dots beside the full-bleed stage photo; key figures strip below; group structure chart next.
options.viewport: 58/42 split cover, top nav with LinkedIn button, four key figures with source notes.
options.risk: The most balanced and least surprising of the three; the dot field is atmosphere behind the name rather than the headline.

options.label: 2 · The figure leads
options.thesis: A full-width ultramarine plate where 72,000 is drawn in dots, one per Developer Kaki member; the founder's statement and photo follow.
options.viewport: The number is the headline; the name sits small in the plate's corner; the photo arrives in the second band.
options.risk: Your name is secondary on first sight; it relies on the caption to explain the number.

options.label: 3 · Contents rail
options.thesis: The report's Contents page is the navigation: a numbered left rail with LinkedIn at its foot, and an ultramarine name plate overlapping the stage photo.
options.viewport: A fixed left rail with six numbered sections; the photo fills the main area; key figures run along the bottom.
options.risk: A fixed rail needs a mobile translation (a contents drawer), and the photo's on-stage slide text shows behind you.
